result.title: tmol: a GPU-accelerated implementation of the Rosetta energy function for machine learning
result.summary: Physics-inspired forcefields complement generative machine learning models, showing better generalization beyond the training distribution. However, these forcefields are typically slow to evaluate, and their derivatives are difficult to integrate into ML frameworks. We introduce tmol, a GPU-native PyTorch library implementing the state-of-the-art RosettaGenFF forcefield. tmol supports efficient batched differentiable scoring and whole-structure refinement with up to 362-fold throughput increase (batched). Used as a reward in generative protein design, tmol increases hydrogen bonds and water bridges at designed interfaces.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作发布 tmol：一个 GPU 原生 PyTorch 库，实现 RosettaGenFF 力场，支持批量可微打分与整体结构精修，并作为奖励用于生成式蛋白质设计。
